idea-plugin.name: Allman View
idea-plugin.description:
Shows your code in Allman style without changing the file.

When a line ends with {, the real brace stays where it is and is simply dimmed, while a phantom line with the brace is drawn underneath at the right indent. The same happens for } else {, } catch {, } finally {.

Nothing is written to the file: copying, search, the compiler and git all see the real text.

action.description: Turn the visual move of opening braces on or off
